reading_notes: Convention A resolves gold by argmax content-token containment. A lexical system also takes an argmax of token overlap, so A flatters it. Convention B's gold is exact string containment and carries no such coupling. Both are reported.
Do not read the pooled row. Data-to-text supplies most scorable spans and its context is a serialised JSON object, so its sentence boundaries come from json.dumps and a regex rather than from prose.
Every interval is a response-level cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 42.
